# Codex App-Server `0.171.0` Identity And Currentness Fixture

Frozen secret-free evidence for `codex.app-server` (`codex.cli` axis) from
`0.164.0` through official stable `0.171.0` (`0.165.0`–`0.171.0`, ten published
stable hops).

- `identity.json`: official npm + GitHub channel agreement, host observation,
  Sigstore TUF trust anchor and `bwrap` provenance (reused from Research 487),
  claim at observation, and segment decision (`codex.app-server` compatible
  extension on `codex.app-server.v2.protected-aws-workspace-roots`;
  `codex.app-server` lifecycle private milestone `0.166.0..=0.171.0` on
  `codex.app-server.lifecycle.v1.best-effort-descendant-restore`).
- `protocol.json`: selected RPC, lifecycle, attached-child, paginated resume,
  managed `config_server`, sandbox/bwrap, and per-file delta classifications.
- `source-inventory.json`: recursive tag source inventory digests and per-version
  SHA-256 digests plus per-hop changed-file lists for all 37 selected feeding
  files.

No downloaded vendor binary was executed; no prompt, login, live session, or
host mutation occurred.
